question.question_text: Which item was used more frequently by the camera wearer during the cooking activity: the knife or the cooking stick?

answer_options.text: Cooking stick was used more frequently
The camera wearer did not use a cooking stick during the cooking activity
Both were used with the same frequency
The camera wearer did not use a spatula during the cooking activity

shared_investigation.established_facts: The camera wearer used the knife multiple times during the cooking activity, including cutting onions, garlic, ginger, and eggplant. The knife was picked up, used, and placed down repeatedly. In contrast, the cooking stick (wooden spoon) was used for stirring food and mushrooms, but the frequency of its use was not as high as the knife. The knife was used more frequently than the cooking stick.

evidence_index.source_content: Camera wearer places onion on chopping board, picks up knife, and cuts onion into pieces while moving it on the board with left hand.
Camera wearer picks up garlic, cuts ginger with knife and picks it up from board, then puts knife down on chopping board.
Camera wearer places phone on table, then picks up garlic from chopping board and cuts it with knife, dropping and picking up garlic multiple times during the process.
Camera wearer stirs mushrooms with wooden spoon and scoops some, puts spoon on board and picks up knife, then stirs food in pot and turns cooker knob, continuing to stir food with spoon.
Camera wearer repeatedly picks up mushrooms from chopping board alternating hands, stirs rice with spoon, and stirs food while turning on cooker.

Camera wearer washes mushrooms at tap and picks one up, cuts mushroom with knife on chopping board, opens fridge and picks up bottle, cuts eggplant with knife, then stirs food in pot while holding pot handle.

Camera wearer picks up container with spoon, turns on cooker and picks up kettle, wipes glass with towel, puts lid on pot and stirs food, picks up bag of vegetables and pours into pan, walks towards fridge, and stirs pot contents while adjusting lid.
